meta.parties: Orloff Et Al. v. Grebe Et Al

rules.statement: A person cannot acquire title by prescription to property belonging to another, even if they have occupied it for a long time with the owner's consent, unless they take some overt act showing an intention to possess adversely to the owner.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a person enters into occupation of property belonging to another with the latter's consent and permission, he cannot acquire title by prescription to such property, unless he gets rid of the character in which he commenced to occupy by doing some overt act showing an intention to possess adversely to the owner."
